definitions.gloss: mock exam; practice test; trial examination
definitions.explanation: A practice examination designed to simulate the format and difficulty of a real test. Very common in the Japanese education system, especially for university entrance exams and professional qualification tests.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来週|らいしゅう}→来週：00746_raishuu⟧{模擬試験|もぎしけん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a mock exam next week.

examples.japanese: {模擬試験|もぎしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{返|かえ}って→返る：29164_kaeru⟧きた⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{悪|わる}かった→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: The mock exam results came back, and they were worse than I expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦{受験生|じゅけんせい}→受験生：18622_jukensei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本番|ほんばん}→本番：19392_honban⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{模擬試験|もぎしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧だ。
examples.english: It's common for exam students to take mock exams many times to prepare for the real thing.

notes:
USAGE:
Often abbreviated to ⟦{模試|もし}→模試：11099_moshi⟧ in casual speech. An essential part of the Japanese exam preparation culture. Major cram schools (⟦{予備校|よびこう}→予備校：04785_yobikou⟧) and testing companies administer nationwide mock exams that give students a ranking and estimated chance of passing their target school's entrance exam.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {模擬試験|もぎしけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to take a mock exam)
- {模擬試験|もぎしけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧ (mock exam results)
- ⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧{模擬試験|もぎしけん} (nationwide mock exam)
- ⟦{模試|もし}→模試：11099_moshi⟧ (abbreviated form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{模試|もし}→模試：11099_moshi⟧: mock exam — the common abbreviation used in everyday speech
- ⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧: entrance exam — the actual entrance examination that mock exams prepare students for
